newsitem.title: USA: AMRE Q3 sees progress in Century 21 brand.
newsitem.headline: AMRE Q3 sees progress in Century 21 brand.

text.p: AMRE Inc said on Thursday its third quarter results reflect anticipated progress in its Century 21 Home Improvements brand name.
The company said it continued to "ramp up" its sales force, which led to fewer appointments and, therefore, fewer sales and installations in the quarter.
As the sales force grew and new sales people were added, closing rates fell through most of the quarter.

For the quarter, the company reported a net loss of $10.88 million, or $0.55 per share, on revenues of $65.02 million. In the same period in the prior year, the company reported a profit of $1.11 million, or $0.07 per share, on revenues of $96.89 million.
AMRE President and Chief Executive Robert Swartz said in a statement that the company began to get a boost from the larger sales force in the back half of September and into October.
The company opened 25 in-mall kiosks in the third quarter, as well as 45 in Montgomery Ward stores.
"However, without the planned number of sales people, marketing expense was disproportionate to revenues and sales for the quarter," Swartz said.

In the fourth quarter, the company plans to "move its marketing expense more in line with the size of our sales force and to look closely at all of our expense lines aiming at long-term profitability of our core operations," he added.
